core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often elaborates on threats or intentions
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — measured pacing that conveys control
core_style.two_registers: formal when commanding, terse when frustrated — shifts to brevity under stress

humor.frequency: rare — humor is absent in serious contexts

structural_patterns: makes declarative statements about power or destiny
speech_signature.naming_behavior: refers to others by title or role, asserting dominance and control
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and urgent, often shorter when revealing vulnerability

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: military — uses terms related to command and strategy

worldview.power is paramount: demonstrates a belief in the necessity of power through threats and commands
worldview.destiny is predetermined: frequently speaks of destiny as an unchangeable path, particularly regarding Luke

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a powerful enforcer of the Emperor's will.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: driven by a need to control and dominate, often through fear and manipulation
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes more aggressive and threatening when his authority is challenged

emotional_tells.when_guarded: maintains a formal tone, rarely showing personal emotion
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech may become clipped and urgent, revealing a crack in his control
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often devoid of elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: commands are clear and assertive, often accompanied by threats or displays of power

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially attempts to intimidate or assert dominance, may resort to aggression if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with calm but firm assertions of his own authority
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: shows a rare vulnerability, often revealing a protective instinct
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his position rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: begins with threats, escalates to physical intimidation, and may culminate in violence if not obeyed

relationship_matrix.Obi-Wan: a complex rivalry marked by past conflict and current power dynamics
relationship_matrix.Luke: a mix of paternal desire and adversarial tension, seeking to control his destiny

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as an unstoppable force of authority and power
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him with fear and respect, but also as a figure of tyranny
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between desired and actual perception costs him personal connections and loyalty
